In real necklaces, there must be visible string, wire, or links holding the beads together. If the beads appear to touch directly without a connector, or if they float slightly apart, this is a strong indicator of AI generation. Also, scrutinize the lighting on the matte surfaces; AI often struggles to render consistent diffuse reflections on non-metallic curved objects.
